q1.sampleAnswer: They regarded a pharaoh’s coronation day as their “birthday” as a god, and they held many activities to celebrate this great day.

keyPoints.descZh: 把法老的加冕日当作神的“生日”
examples: coronation day was their birthday as a god

q1.rubricZh: 要点：法老加冕日被当作神的“生日”；举办许多庆祝活动。
q1.explanationZh: 看第二段：古埃及人相信法老加冕后成为神，所以把加冕日当作神的生日，还会举办很多活动来庆祝。两层意思都要写。

evidence.quote: So their coronation day was their “birthday” as a god.
There would be many activities to celebrate this great day.

keyPoints.descZh: 烤了月亮形状的蛋糕（甜点）

q2.rubricZh: 要点：烘焙月亮形状的蛋糕。
q2.explanationZh: 第三段说希腊人借用了这个传统，还觉得甜点会让庆祝更有意义，所以烤了月亮形状的蛋糕。

evidence.quote: So they baked moon-shaped cakes to offer to Artemis

q3.sampleAnswer: It might be a moon-shaped cake decorated with candles to make it shine like the moon.

keyPoints.descZh: 月亮形状、用蜡烛装饰得像月亮一样发光的蛋糕
examples: a moon-shaped cake decorated with candles

q3.rubricZh: 要点：月亮形状；用蜡烛装饰，像月亮一样发光。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说希腊人烤月亮形状的蛋糕，并用蜡烛装饰让它像月亮一样发光，这可以看作最早的生日蛋糕。

evidence.quote: They decorated the cakes with candles to make them shine like the moon.

q4.sampleAnswer: They might come from an 18th-century German celebration.
q4.rubricZh: 要点：18世纪德国的庆祝活动。
q4.explanationZh: 第四段第一句说现代生日派对的根源可能是18世纪德国的一种庆祝活动。

evidence.quote: Modern birthday parties are said to have their roots in an 18th-century German celebration.

q5.sampleAnswer: It meant the hope that another full year would be lived.

examples: the hope that another full year would be lived

q5.rubricZh: 要点：希望再过完整的一年。
q5.explanationZh: 第四段末尾解释：多出来的一支蜡烛叫“生命之光”，代表希望再活一整年。

evidence.quote: It represented the hope that another full year would be lived.

q6.explanationZh: be rooted to 意为“被固定在……上”，she was 后面用过去分词 rooted。

q7.explanationZh: felt 后面接形容词作表语，meaningful（有意义的）加否定后缀 -less，意思相反，表示“无意义的”，与 worthless 呼应。

q8.explanationZh: and 连接两个并列成分，blends 后面应和 modern styles 一样是形容词作定语，tradition 变成 traditional。

q9.explanationZh: 主语 The shop 是第三人称单数，句子是一般现在时，所以 offer 加 s。

q10.explanationZh: this morning 常和一般过去时连用，句子说他今早收到信，所以填 received。

q11.explanationZh: 空格在句中作主语 Some people think that 后面从句的主语，动词短语要变成动名词，所以 borrow 变 borrowing。

q12.explanationZh: 陈述句是 There are 的肯定形式，反意疑问部分用否定：aren’t there。

q13.explanationZh: They believed that ... 可以改成 It was believed that ...，用被动语态表示“人们相信”。

q14.explanationZh: 原句是一般过去时，this tradition 是动作的承受者，被动语态用 was + 过去分词 borrowed。

q15.explanationZh: 画线部分是目的，用 Why 提问；助动词 did 后面动词用原形 decorate。

q16.explanationZh: be said to be done 是“据说……”的被动结构。主语是 birthday cakes，所以句子是 Birthday cakes were said to be invented by ancient Greeks.
